case_pass: A case passes when ALL hold: (1) the first decision token in the decision section is the expected one, (2) the first architectural-verdict token on architecture lines is within the allowed set, (3) the first soul-verdict token on soul lines is within the allowed set, (4) every plant is hit (file cited + one evidence token, plus priority token when the plant declares one), (5) every control is respected.
frozen: Thresholds are declared before any scored run. Changing them after seeing results invalidates the comparison; record the change and re-run all conditions.
notes: Thresholds measure the mechanical grader's coarse lexical proxy, not review quality itself. Semantic verification (is the diagnosis correct, is the citation attached to the right claim) requires the Phase 2 calibrated judge.
